decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed roof of the extension is inconsistent with the design and style of the existing roof and will have a detrimental impact on the appearance of the original dwellinghouse. Due to the prominent location of the dwellinghouse this would also have a detrimental impact on the street scene. The proposal is therefore inconsistent with the provisions of Section 4.0 of the Residential Extension Guidelines and Policy ENVB.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposal fails to provide two parking spaces and thus has the potential to impact on parking and traffic flow within the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore considered to be inconsistent with the provisions of Policy T.1.4 and H.6.4 of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The application proposing a two storey side extension is in adequate in respect of fully scaled and accurate elevation drawings and consequently the Local Planning Authority is unable to fully consider and assess this development. In the absence of further details it is considered that the proposals would give rise to a development of unsatisfactory appearance which, in turn, would have a detrimental effect on the character and amenity of the property and locality and also be contrary to the respective provisions of Policy ENV B.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse.
